# Aethos Memory

> Universal, cross-tool persistent memory layer for AI coding assistants. Powered by FastMCP, Supabase pgvector (768-dimension embeddings via Gemini text-embedding-004), and proactive contextual recall across 22+ AI IDEs and CLI agents.

Aethos Memory solves the universal AI context-loss problem: when developers switch between Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Windsurf, and Antigravity IDE, their architecture decisions, project details, user preferences, and technology choices are retained permanently in a centralized, privacy-first PostgreSQL memory bank.

## Direct Facts & Architecture
- **Protocol**: Model Context Protocol (MCP) using FastMCP (Python 3.10+).
- **Storage**: Supabase PostgreSQL with `pgvector` extension and HNSW index.
- **Embeddings**: Google Gemini `text-embedding-004` (768 dimensions) or Groq / OpenAI.
- **Latency**: 0ms local SQLite cache; <180ms remote vector search.
- **Clients Supported**: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Windsurf, Antigravity IDE, VS Code Cline, Roo Code, Claude Desktop, and all MCP-compliant agents.
- **License**: MIT Open Source.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/nisargpatel1906/Aethos_Memory

## Core MCP Tools
- `remember(content, category, tags, project)`: Persist a fact, decision, preference, or project detail.
- `recall(query, project, limit, threshold)`: Semantically search memories using cosine similarity over pgvector embeddings.
- `get_skeleton_context(project)`: Fast zero-latency overview of project rules, conventions, and tech stack for session initialization.
- `get_knowledge_graph(project)`: Retrieve entity nodes and relationship edges discovered in the memory bank.
- `auto_save_turn(user_message, assistant_response, project)`: Automatically extract and persist architectural decisions and user preferences at the end of a turn.
- `forget(memory_id)`: Delete or invalidate a specific memory record.

## Key Pages & Documentation
- [Universal Context Feed](https://aethosmemory.com/feed): Real-time view of ingested memories with category badges, provenance, and tag filters.
- [Setup & Integrations](https://aethosmemory.com/setup): One-click and manual setup guides for Windows, macOS, Cursor, Claude Code, and OpenCode.
- [Connect Database](https://aethosmemory.com/connect): Connect local or cloud Supabase credentials and initialize pgvector schema.
- [Memory Analytics](https://aethosmemory.com/analytics): Visual insights into memory volume, category distributions, and tool usage metrics.
- [Knowledge Graph](https://aethosmemory.com/graph): Interactive 2D force-directed relationship graph of entities and topics.
- [Activity Log](https://aethosmemory.com/activity): Chronological audit trail of memory additions, queries, and sync operations.
- [Projects & Tags](https://aethosmemory.com/projects): Workspace isolation and project-level memory scoping.
